row.answer_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kumwarifu WCF kuhusu ajali ya kazi ndani ya siku saba (7) ZA KAZI baada ya ajali kutokea — kwa njia ya portal ya mtandao ya WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz). row.question_en: If a worker is injured at work within what timeframe must the employer notify WCF?
row.answer_en: The employer must notify WCF of a workplace accident within 7 WORKING DAYS of it occurring — through the WCF online portal (portal.wcf.go.tz). For serious or fatal accidents OSHA must be notified within 24 hours. Failure to report on time results in penalties and may affect the worker's claim.

row.question_en: What is the difference between OSHA and WCF accident reporting in Tanzania?
row.answer_en: Two separate systems: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — employer reports the accident via portal.wcf.go.tz within 7 working days after the accident. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) — OSHA conducts workplace inspections; an inspector may issue an improvement notice or a prohibition notice. Employers must also report major accidents to OSHA separately. These systems are complementary — comply with both. Confirm with WCF and OSHA.
